description: Find EV charging stations from the global Open Charge Map registry near a point, within a bounding box, or along a route. Provide one location: a center (latitude + longitude + distance), a boundingbox, or a route (its points in travel order, with distance as the corridor half-width); optionally scope to a country with countrycode. This tool is coordinate-native and does not geocode place names — resolve a place like "Ballard, Seattle" to coordinates with openstreetmap_search_places first, then pass them here. Filter by connector type, minimum power (kW), operator/network, usage type (public, membership required, pay at location, private; price is not a usage type), charge level, operational status, and minimum charge points. Filter IDs are integers — resolve a connector or network name to its IDs with openchargemap_lookup_reference and pass every returned ID (e.g. "CCS" -> [32, 33]; Open Charge Map distinguishes CCS Type 1 (32, common in North America) and Type 2 (33, common in Europe); 33 alone can miss Type 1 stations). Each result includes title, address, distance from the search point (along a route: routeDistance along it and offRouteDistance off it), connections (type, power, count), operator, access rules, usage type ID, usage cost when on record, registry operational status, the last-verified date, and the data provider with its ID; the text output lists the license terms of each provider once per page, after the stations. Results come back one page at a time: when a page reports truncated, repeat the same search with the reported nextOffset to read the next one.

boundingbox.description: Bounding-box search as an alternative to a center+radius. The box is searched outward from its center, so its stations come back nearest the center first, each with its distance from the center in distanceUnit. The latitude corners may come in either order; a sw_lng greater than ne_lng spans the ±180° meridian (e.g. sw_lng 170, ne_lng -170 is the 20° around it, not the 340° between). Mutually exclusive with latitude/longitude/distance and route — sending a boundingbox alongside a latitude or a longitude is rejected, not resolved in favour of one of them.

anyOf.description: Several reference IDs, OR-matched. At least one.

connectiontypeid.description: Connector type ID, or an array of IDs (OR-matched). Resolve names with openchargemap_lookup_reference — e.g. CCS is two IDs, 32 (Type 1, North America) and 33 (Type 2, Europe and most other regions), so pass [32, 33] when the region is unknown; CHAdeMO=2, NACS/Tesla Supercharger=27, Type 2 socket=25, Type 1/J1772=1.

countrycode.description: Restrict to one country by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "US", "FR", "GB"). Omit for a global search. An unrecognized code is not applied; the summary and notice disclose the unrestricted search. Resolve valid codes with openchargemap_lookup_reference (countries).

distance.description: Search radius from the center point — or, along a route, the corridor half-width: how far from the route a station may sit — in the unit given by distanceUnit (default km). Max 500. For a radius, keep small (5-25) in dense urban areas and widen for rural coverage; for a driving corridor, 2-10 km is typical.

distanceUnit.description: Unit for the distance parameter and the returned distance values.

latitude.description: Center latitude (WGS84 decimal degrees). Use with longitude + distance for a radius search. Resolve place names via openstreetmap_search_places first.

anyOf.description: Several reference IDs, OR-matched. At least one.

levelid.description: Charge level ID (1=Low <2kW, 2=Medium >2kW, 3=High >40kW/fast). Array OR-matched. Use 3 as a coarse "fast charging only" filter when a specific connector is not required.

longitude.description: Center longitude (WGS84 decimal degrees). Use with latitude + distance for a radius search.

maxresults.description: Maximum stations to return, nearest the search point first — the center of a radius search or of a bounding box — or in route order along a route. Max 200; larger values are clamped to 200.

minchargepoints.description: Minimum number of charge points (stalls) at the station. Filters out single-point locations when you need a station likely to have an open stall.

minpowerkw.description: Minimum charging power in kW across any connection at the station. Use ~50 for DC fast charging, ~150 for high-power DC. Stations whose fastest connection is below this are excluded.

offset.description: Matching stations to skip before the returned page, for reading past a truncated result. Repeat the same search with the nextOffset value the previous call reported. One search reaches at most 500 stations, so 499 is the deepest offset that can return one — narrow the area or add filters to reach stations beyond that. Ordering is by distance from the search point (a bounding box's center), or along a route by routeDistance then offRouteDistance, with station ID breaking ties, and stable, but Open Charge Map is edited continuously, so a station added or removed between pages can shift what a later offset lands on.

anyOf.description: Several reference IDs, OR-matched. At least one.

operatorid.description: Operator/network ID, or array of IDs (OR-matched). Resolve a network name with openchargemap_lookup_reference (category "operators") — e.g. "Tesla", "ChargePoint".

route.description: Search along a route instead of around a point or in a box: its points in travel order, 2 to 500 of them — waypoints, or a routing service's geometry. Each leg runs the shortest way between its two points, and distance becomes the corridor half-width. Stations within it come back in the order a driver meets them, each with routeDistance (along the route from its first point) and offRouteDistance (off the route), in distanceUnit. Mutually exclusive with latitude/longitude and boundingbox. Each leg must span less than 180° of longitude, so a route cannot cross ±180°.

anyOf.description: Several reference IDs, OR-matched. At least one.

statustypeid.description: Registry operational-status ID, or array (OR-matched). Resolve via openchargemap_lookup_reference (category "statustypes"). NOTE: registry status is operator-reported and can be stale — combine with dateLastVerified and openchargemap_get_station_comments to judge real-world reliability, do not treat it as ground truth.

anyOf.description: Several reference IDs, OR-matched. At least one.

usagetypeid.description: Usage/access type ID, or array (OR-matched). Resolve via openchargemap_lookup_reference (category "usagetypes") — e.g. Public=1, Public-Pay At Location=5, Public-Membership Required=4.

name: openchargemap_find_stations

attribution.description: Attribution to Open Charge Map contributors and station data providers; license terms vary by provider.

cap.description: The maxresults cap that was applied.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_location`: No search area was provided; or only one half of a center arrived; or a boundingbox or a route arrived alongside another location or a stray latitude or longitude; or Open Charge Map cannot search the route — a leg spans 180° of longitude or more, the corridor reaches past a pole or ±180° longitude, or the request runs past the 8,177 bytes Open Charge Map accepts. `upstream_unavailable`: OCM returned a non-2xx response or timed out. `auth_failed`: OCM returned HTTP 401 or 403 — the API key is missing or invalid. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextOffset.description: The offset to pass on an otherwise identical call to read the next page. Absent when nothing further was retrieved.

notice.description: How to reach the stations this page left out, or why it came back empty.

searchSummary.description: Human-readable echo of the resolved search: location mode, scope, and active filters as the server applied them.

stations.description: Matching stations, nearest the search point first — the center of a radius search or of a bounding box — or in route order along a route.

line2.description: Second address line (e.g. a district or building). Absent when none on record.

connections.description: Connectors at the station. Empty when OCM has no connection data on record.

connectionTypeId.description: Connector type ID — resolve via openchargemap_lookup_reference.

isOperational.description: Faithful registry operational flag for this connector; absent when unknown.

powerKW.description: Rated power in kW for this connection. null/absent when unknown.

quantity.description: Number of connectors of this type. null when unknown.

status.description: Registry status title for this connector.

statusTypeId.description: Registry status ID for this connector; absent when no status ID is on record.

dataProviderId.description: OCM data provider ID. Provider titles are not unique — two providers can share one with different license terms — so the ID is what identifies the provider.

dataProviderLicense.description: License terms supplied by the station data provider. Absent when unspecified.

dateLastVerified.description: ISO 8601 date the listing was last verified. Stale (>12 months) is a reliability caveat. null when never verified.

distance.description: Distance from the search point: the center of a radius search or of a bounding box. Absent along a route, which reports routeDistance and offRouteDistance instead.

distanceUnit.description: Unit of distance, routeDistance, and offRouteDistance.

isAccessKeyRequired.description: Whether a physical access key is required. Absent when usage type is unknown.

isMembershipRequired.description: Whether a membership or RFID card is required. Absent when usage type is unknown.

isOpenDataLicensed.description: Whether the provider marks its data as openly licensed. Absent when unknown.

isOperational.description: Whether the registry marks the status operational. Absent when the operational state is unknown. A true value can still mask a broken charger — corroborate with comments and dateLastVerified.

isPayAtLocation.description: Whether payment is required at the location. Absent when usage type is unknown.

isRecentlyVerified.description: Whether the listing was verified recently.

numberOfPoints.description: Reported number of charge points (stalls). Often absent — absence means unknown, not zero.

offRouteDistance.description: Route searches only: distance from the station to its nearest point on the route — the detour off it. At most the requested distance.

operator.description: Operating network name (e.g. "ChargePoint", "Tesla"). Absent when OCM has no operator on record.

operatorId.description: OCM operator ID — resolve names via openchargemap_lookup_reference.

routeDistance.description: Route searches only: distance along the route from its first point to the station's nearest point on the route — the order a driver meets stations.

status.description: Registry operational status (e.g. "Operational", "Temporarily Unavailable"). Operator-reported; may be stale.

statusTypeId.description: Registry status ID — the value the openchargemap_find_stations statustypeid filter takes. Absent when OCM has no status on record.

usageCost.description: Free-text cost description as recorded (e.g. "£0.30/kWh"). Often absent — absence means unknown, not free.

usageType.description: Access/usage type title (e.g. "Public", "Public - Pay At Location"). Absent when OCM has no usage type.

usageTypeId.description: Usage type ID — the value the openchargemap_find_stations usagetypeid filter takes. 0 is OCM's "(Unknown)" type. Absent when OCM has no usage type on record.

uuid.description: OCM station UUID — stable cross-system identifier (cannot be used as a lookup input).

totalCount.description: Matching stations in the retrieved pool of up to 500 candidates, before offset/maxresults selects the page. Exact when no additional upstream stations remain; otherwise a floor. Stable across pages while the pool remains cached. The notice states whether additional upstream stations exist.

truncated.description: True when matching stations were left out of the returned page.

title: openchargemap-mcp-server: find stations
